error.message: The loop through MIX13, MIX3, PUMP14, KREA4, SCDS5, HTXR6, MIX7, EXTR8, SPLIT9, HTXR19, HTXR10, HTXR18, SCDS15, SCDS11, SPLIT16, HTXR12, HTXR17 did not converge: at iteration 8, Extraction EXTR8: the feeds mixed together make one liquid at 300.1 K (no liquid-liquid split), so they cannot be extracted as given. Use less solvent, another solvent, or another temperature. (on an accelerated guess, broyden, 1100 % of the tear flows beyond the last pass's result; the last pass changed the tears by 3.40e-4. Check the specifications and the start values of the loop first; direct substitution, which never extrapolates, shows whether the guess was the cause). What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear streams (S27, S7, S21, S15, S24) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
